name: Steel Hawk Berhad
overview: Steel Hawk Berhad 今年通过全资子公司 Steel Hawk Manufacturing Sdn Bhd 以 RM1,100,000 认购 Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd 约 55% 扩大后股本，Sparksfly 成为其子公司；同时 Steel Hawk Digital 与 Steel Hawk Infrastructure 分别与 Teczo 及 Jovitech 的 MOU 年内无重大进展。公司另完成最多 245,279,000 份免费凭单的 bonus issue。
overview_en: Steel Hawk Berhad this year, through wholly-owned subsidiary Steel Hawk Manufacturing Sdn Bhd, subscribed for approximately 55% of the enlarged issued share capital of Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd for RM1,100,000 cash, making Sparksfly a subsidiary; meanwhile the MOUs between Steel Hawk Digital and Teczo, and between Steel Hawk Infrastructure and Jovitech, saw no material development during the year. The company also completed a bonus issue of up to 245,279,000 free warrants.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 年内完成对 Sparksfly O&G 的多数股权认购，并推进凭单发行；两项子公司 MOU 无重大进展。
segments.note_en: Completed the majority stake subscription in Sparksfly O&G and progressed the warrants issuance during the year; two subsidiary MOUs saw no material development.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 认购事项于 2026 年 9 月 30 日完成，Sparksfly 成为子公司。
actions.text_en: The proposed subscription was completed on 30 September 2026, with Sparksfly becoming a subsidiary.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 认购协议的先决条件截止日由 2026 年 8 月 30 日延长至 2026 年 9 月 30 日。
actions.text_en: The long stop date for the conditions precedent of the subscription agreement was extended from 30 August 2026 to 30 September 2026.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Steel Hawk Digital Sdn Bhd 与 Teczo Sdn Bhd 的 MOU 自上次公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development on the MOU between Steel Hawk Digital Sdn Bhd and Teczo Sdn Bhd since the last announcement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Steel Hawk Infrastructure Sdn Bhd 与 Jovitech Solution Sdn Bhd 的 MOU 自上次公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development on the MOU between Steel Hawk Infrastructure Sdn Bhd and Jovitech Solution Sdn Bhd since the last announcement.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司 Steel Hawk Manufacturing Sdn Bhd 于 2026 年 7 月 30 日签订有条件认购协议，以 RM1,100,000 现金认购 Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd 611,112 股新股，约占其扩大后已发行股本 55%。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Steel Hawk Manufacturing Sdn Bhd entered into a conditional subscription agreement on 30 July 2026 to subscribe for 611,112 new ordinary shares in Sparksfly O&G Sdn Bhd, representing approximately 55% of its enlarged issued share capita…

actions.text: Steel Hawk Digital Sdn Bhd 与 Teczo Sdn Bhd 的 MOU 无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development on the MOU between Steel Hawk Digital Sdn Bhd and Teczo Sdn Bhd.

actions.text: Steel Hawk Infrastructure Sdn Bhd 与 Jovitech Solution Sdn Bhd 的 MOU 无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development on the MOU between Steel Hawk Infrastructure Sdn Bhd and Jovitech Solution Sdn Bhd.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED BONUS ISSUE OF UP TO 245,279,000 FREE WARRANTS IN STEEL HAWK ("WARRANT(S)") ON THE BASI
actions.text: 发行最多 245,279,000 份免费凭单。
actions.text_en: Proposed bonus issue of up to 245,279,000 free warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 2 existing ordinary shares held.
